title: Old Roads
summary: Col the carter's grandmother was a hedge-caller. The old Wickham road runs under the Keep's cellars, older than the Keep. If your company holds there, he'll show your shamans the breath she taught him (the shaman's level-6 skill).

steps.journal: Hold six waves in Wickham Keep, on the Wickham road north of the crossroads.

ready: Go back to Col the carter, in Thornwick's square.
done: Col taught your shamans Ancestors' Breath, the way his grandmother taught him: one for you, one for them.
